name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/runtime/bootstrap - One control-plane request per voice call
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN; the voice runtime's only control-plane call per call, VA-ADR-8). Bootstraps a new call with ONE request that returns agent version, stack, key handles, tools and a session token (0b67f69e-f84c-4478-89b5-46df70beff6f#AC1). Body: exactly one of { call_id } (browser test sessions and outbound calls carry it in their LiveKit dispatch metadata) or { inbound: { to, from?, room, sip_call_id? } } for an inbound SIP call. action=agent returns: call (created for inbound: direction inbound, status in_progress, one call per LiveKit room so a retry reuses it), agent (version_id, version_no, system_prompt, greeting, language, escalation_rules, business_hours, kb_corpus_ids), stack.layers for stt / llm_fast / llm_complex / tts with provider, model, voice, options and DECRYPTED key handles primary { binding_id, provider, key } and secondary (the failover target, with its fallback config; null when unset or revoked) — telephony keys are never released — routing (voice.fast / voice.complex: where each LLM tier points after the tenant's ai-gateway route rules whose predicate is exactly {task_tag: voice.fast|voice.complex} — a routed provider uses the tenant's active llm key for it and the stack model becomes its failover; resolved once per call), recording (permitted, notice, basis, rule, jurisdiction: outbound follows the dialer recording gate stored on the call; inbound follows the caller's jurisdiction rule — prohibited = not recorded and no notice, otherwise recorded WITH the spoken notice, persisted as the call's recording_consent; test calls follow their own flag), tools (the version's enabled app tools: name, json_schema, url, timeout_ms, idempotent and the HMAC signing_secret the runtime signs requests with), session_token (the call's capability token, always re-issued so a restarted runtime gets a fresh bearer and the lost one is revoked), expires_at, first_bootstrap. The first bootstrap stamps context.runtime, marks a test call in_progress and emits voice.call.started.v1 listing the released key binding ids (never values). An inbound number whose agent is unpublished, paused, archived or kill-switched answers 200 action=fallback with reason, fallback, fallback_target and kill_message. Response is Cache-Control: no-store. Errors: neither/both of call_id and inbound, malformed call_id, inbound without to/room 400; unknown call or unbound number 404; ended call, no agent version, or a stack whose required key is missing/revoked 409 (StackIncomplete); session tokens not wired 503; missing/wrong ops token 401/403. The fixture chain binds only an llm_fast key, so bootstrapping its test-session call answers 409 StackIncomplete — the fully keyed action=agent path is proven by the voice-runtime e2e.
